title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards — Redemption-Size Goodwill on Merchandise Purchases Gift Card Claims
content:
On a gift card claim for a Merchandise Purchases unit, goodwill is banded by the largest gift card redemption entry naming the unit in the Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards ledger, Bonus Card entries included:

| Largest redemption entry naming the unit | Redemption-size goodwill |
|---|---|
| $100.00 or more (the large redemption size) | large redemption-size goodwill, $6.00 |
| $25.00 or more but below $100.00 (the middle redemption size) | middle redemption-size goodwill, $3.00 |

A unit whose largest such entry is below $25.00 is outside these bands.

## Both sides of each band (hypothetical entries)

| Redemption entries naming the unit | Largest | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|
| $100.00 | $100.00 | $6.00 |
| $60.00 and $50.00 | $60.00 | $3.00 |
| $25.00 | $25.00 | $3.00 |
| $20.00 and $20.00 (Bonus Card) | $20.00 | outside these bands |
